items.question: By what numerical scope is the claim made that certain beings endure torment within womb-diagrams?
premises: A count of eighty-four is specified for the setting.
That count is placed among thousands of locations.
Those locations are identified as womb-diagrams.
Beings in those locations are said to be tormented.
items.inference: Torment is assigned to beings situated within eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams.
uncertainties: The exact identity of the beings remains unspecified by this verse alone.
items.plain_english: In eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams, beings are tormented.
